title: Quantity
description: An instrument quantity or price, represented as a base-10 decimal string plus explicit scale metadata where the venue requires it (docs/03).

unit.description: Unit of measure for the quantity.

scale.description: Explicit scale metadata required by the venue. Venue precision is validated before submission (docs/03).

x-invariants: Venue precision and lot size are validated before submission; a non-conforming quantity is rejected, never rounded silently.
Rounding is only ever performed by an explicitly named, audited rounding policy, and the applied policy is recorded with the decision.
Positive and negative quantities are both valid; direction is carried by the order side, not the sign of the quantity.
